name: Eternal dream
source:
Welcome! Misha, Petya and Kesha are already ready for school days, and you?
Playing as the main character (Misha), you will feel peace and enjoy the game without thinking about anything. There will be many difficulties on Misha's way, which he will cope with together with his best friends!✦

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240819161005/https://niceed.itch.io/eternal-dream]Itch.io[/url]]
